title: WorkSurface Authority Namespace
$comment: Stable namespace of one durable WorkSurface storage authority. It is persisted before accepting durable identities, survives Runtime process restarts, and is never model-authored or part of the stable model semantic contract. Same-principal filesystem secrecy is not assumed.

relativePath.$comment: A filesystem-relative locator, not a URL. Percent escapes, URL query/fragment syntax, absolute paths, URI schemes, Windows separators, control characters, and dot segments are rejected before resolution.
